runs.text: The Fezara are an ethnic group of Sudan, who emigrated from Arabia to Egypt, and then to Sudan. The Fezara are only found in Sudan.

They live in portable, dome-shaped tents called furgan, often arranged in a circle around their cattle. Their cultural practices are similiar to other northern Sudanese Arab tribes, such as the Baggare.

Sudan is one of the world’s poorest and least developed countries, ranking 170th on the 2024 Human Development Index and 185th in GDP per capita. Its economy relies heavily on agriculture, hindered by international sanctions, isolation, and internal conflict.
Sudan is facing the world’s worst displacement crisis and record
hunger
, with over 95% of the population unable to afford one meal a day, according to a February 2024 WFP report.
Evangelical work among the Fezara is extremely challenging. Their strong devotion to Islam and nomadic lifestyle make outreach difficult.
Currently, there are no missionaries or believers working among them, and no significant diaspora outside Sudan.
Sudan is number 5 on the Open Doors 2025 World Watch List. It’s a land where Christians face extreme levels of persecution. Conflict makes a terrible situation harder for the followers of Jesus.

God hears the cry of the Fezara people. God is weeping, and so are the Fezara people. God understands their difficulties, but instead of directly changing their circumstances, He shows them deep love. And He is inviting His sons and daughters to love them.
“If you spend yourselves on behalf of the
hungry
and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.”
Isaiah 58:10 (NIV)

Pray that the Lord will shine His light and hope upon the Fezara who live in deep poverty and instability. May they experience His provision, protection, and love even in the midst of hunger and hardship.
Pray that God will intervene in Sudan—bringing peace,
providing for the hungry
and displaced, and protecting believers as they stand firm in their faith.
Pray that God would send workers to serve among the Fezara people, and that their hearts would be opened to Jesus Christ, receiving His love and truth.
Pray for a movement to Christ to sweep through the Baggara tribes and spread to the Fezara as well.
